security.csp: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost https://ipapi.co

bundle.shortDescription: Estimate what your PC costs in electricity
bundle.longDescription: PowerCost runs quietly in the tray, estimates your PC's power use by state (active, idle, sleep, off) and tariff period, and shows what it costs. Everything stays on your computer.
